goal: Fix the confirmed hunsu tree_fingerprint false drift between identical Claude/Codex plugin payloads caused by Codex's root .codex-marketplace-install.json installer receipt: ignore that exact root path only, keep every real content change visible, and document that locks whose hash included the receipt need an explicit relock after payload verification
brief: Add regression tests to the existing test_hunsu.py (plain test_ functions run by its __main__; keep every existing test unchanged) for the contract's receipt sections. Use temporary trees and the file's fake Host fixtures only — never a real plugin cache, ~/.claude, ~/.codex or another project. The Q-receipt-ignored and Q-cross-host tests must fail against the current hunsu.py; tests that guard what already holds (Q-real-content, Q-exact-path, the unchanged no-receipt fingerprint and existing exclusions of Q-no-migration) are expected to pass before the build — they keep the fix narrow. Run under python3 (3.11+).
